ayahOccurrences.text: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ

ayahOccurrences.text: وَلَمَّا بَرَزُوا۟ لِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

ayahOccurrences.text: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٌ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَآخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَآخَرُونَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًا ۚ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌۢ

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 3rd person feminine singular (form II) perfect verb
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: قَدَّمَتْ is in the derivative form: قَدَّمَ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ق/د/م q–d–m foot
; position, rank, leader, to lead; to come, to arrive; front, to advance, fore, in the front; brave, courageous; to precede, to be old, ancient, eternal; to submit.

Of this root, 10 forms occur 48 times in the Qur’an:
قَدِمَ qadima 1 time; يَقْدُم yaqdum 1 time; قَدَّمَ qaddama 27 times; تَقَدَّمَ taqaddama 2 times; تَسْتَقْدِمُون tastaqdimūn 4 times; قَدَم qadam 2 times; أَقْدَام ʾaqdām 6 times; قَدِيم qadım 3 times; أَقْدَمُون ʾaqdamūn 1 time and مُسْتَقْدِمِين mustaqdimın 1 time.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
قَدَّمَ qaddama [v. II, trans.]

1 to advance, to put forward, to offer

(58:13) ءَأَشْفَقْتُمْ أَنْ تُقَدِّمُوا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ نَجْوَاكُمْ صَدَقَاتٍ have you found it burdensome to give alms before your private consultation [with the Prophet]?

2 [with an elliptical object] to work for, to show concern, to provide

(89:24) يَقُولُ يَالَيْتَنِي قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِي he will say, ‘Would that I had provided for my life [here]!’

3 to offer, to make available, to bring upon

(38:60) أَنْتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا it was you who brought this on us

4 to tempt, to entice, to allure, to beguile

(5:80) لَبِئْسَ مَا قَدَّمَتْ لَهُمْ أَنْفُسُهُمْ أَنْ سَخِطَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ how vile is what their souls have beguiled them into! God is wroth with them as a result ‏‏

5 to commit, to perpetrate, to incur

(3:18–2) ذَلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَيْسَ بِظَلاَّمٍ لِلْعَبِيدِ this is on account of what you have committed with your own hands: God is never unjust to [His] servants.

entries.label: أَقْدَمُون
entries.definitionHtml:
أَقْدَمُون ʾaqdamūn [pl. of elat. أَقْدَم ʾaqdam] older/oldest, more/most ancient *

(26:76) ءَابَاؤُكُمُ الأَقْدَمُونَ your forefathers, ‏your ancestors, your predecessors.

entries.label: تَقَدَّم
entries.definitionHtml:
تَقَدَّم taqaddama [v. V, intrans.]

1 to go before

(48:2) لِيَغْفِرَ لَكَ اللَّهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ that God may forgive you those of your sins that are past [lit. long gone] and those yet to come

2 to go forward, to advance

(74:37) لِمَنْ شَاءَ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ to those of you who choose to go ahead or lag behind.

entries.label: قَدَم
entries.definitionHtml:
قَدَم qadam [n.; pl. أَقْدَام ʾaqdām] foot, foothold *

(16:94) فَتَزِلَّ قَدَمٌ بَعْدَ ثُبُوتِهَا lest you sin after having attained to faith [lit. lest a foot should slip after it has been firmly placed]; *

(10:2) قَدَمَ صِدْقٍ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ in good standing (or, on a sure footing) with their Lord; *‏

(55:41) فَيُؤْخَذُ بِالنَّوَاصِي وَالأَقْدَامِ and will be seized by the forelocks and the feet‏; *

(41:29) نَجْعَلْهُمَا تَحْتَ أَقْدَامِنَا so we may ‏humiliate them [lit. so we may put them under our feet]; *

(8:11) وَيُثَبِّتَ بِهِ الأَقْدَامَ and with which to strengthen the resolution [lit. and with which to make feet firm].

entries.label: قَدِمَ
entries.definitionHtml:
قَدِمَ qadima a [v. intrans.] to come to, to apply oneself to, to turn to

(25:23) وَقَدِمْنَا إِلَى مَا عَمِلُوا مِنْ عَمَلٍ فَجَعَلْنَاهُ هَبَاءً مَنْثُورًا and We will turn to whatever [good] deeds they have done and scatter them like dust.

entries.label: قَدِيم
entries.definitionHtml:
قَدِيم qadım [quasi-act. part.]

1 ancient

(46:11) وَإِذْ لَمْ يَهْتَدُوا بِهِ فَسَيَقُولُونَ هَذَا إِفْكٌ قَدِيمٌ and, since they will not be guided by it, they say, ‘This is an ancient fabrication’

2 old, shrivelled

(36:39) وَالْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَاهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّى عَادَ كَالْعُرْجُونِ الْقَدِيمِ and the moon, We have determined it by stations until it becomes like a shrivelled, old date-palm stalk

3 customary, familiar, same old (thing)

(12:95) قَالُوا تَاللَّهِ إِنَّكَ لَفِى ضَلاَلِكَ الْقَدِيمِ they said, ‘By God, you are still in your old delusions!’

entries.label: مُسْتَقْدِمِين
entries.definitionHtml:
مُسْتَقْدِمِين mustaqdimın [pl. of act. part. مُسْتَقْدِم mustaqdim] past generations; those who lead others in good work; the vanguard

(15:24) وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا الْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنْكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا الْمُسْتَأْخِرِينَ and We have come to know those of you who press forward and We know the laggards.

entries.label: يَسْتَقْدِم
entries.definitionHtml:
يَسْتَقْدِم yastaqdim [imperf. of v. X, trans.] to seek to advance, to seek to bring forward

(16:61) فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَجَلُهُمْ لاَ يَسْتَأْخِرُونَ سَاعَةً وَلاَ يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ and when their time comes they are unable to put it off for an hour nor [can they] bring it forward [for an hour].

entries.label: يَقْدُم
entries.definitionHtml:
يَقْدُم yaqdum [imperf. of v. قَدَمَ qadama, trans.] to precede

(11:98) يَقْدُمُ قَوْمَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةَ he will be at the forefront of his people on the Day of Resurrection.
